name: pr-cards
description: GitHub pull request chips with hover cards in the Claude Code transcript.

cardStyle.title: Card style
cardStyle.description: How the hover card looks: card, the full card with checks, reviews and threads; or github, laid out as GitHub's own hover card.

trackedBand.title: Tracked PRs above the prompt
trackedBand.description: A click on a reference adds it to a band above the prompt, with actions for the selected one. Off: a click does nothing.

bandPerRow.title: Tracked PRs per row
bandPerRow.description: How many tracked PRs fit on one row of a group in the band, 1 to 6; more start a new row.

shareTracked.title: Share tracked PRs per repo
shareTracked.description: Sessions in the same GitHub repo (its worktrees too), or the same folder outside git, show one tracked list. Off: each session keeps its own.
